messages:
Maria (Growth): quick sync — final pass on landing copy for the tri-mode pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). goal: one launch post + webinar CTA + guided inbound routing for each persona. who can do quick takes? :rocket:
Sofia (Content): I can draft two hero variations per mode today. one product-focused, one outcomes-focused. examples: "Hosted API: Start building with low-latency, pay-as-you-go inference." and "Dedicated: Predictable throughput for mission-critical apps."
Ben (Design): need copy lengths: hero short (6–9 words), subhead ~12–18 words, primary CTA, secondary CTA. standardize across pages?
Jake (PM): yes — standardize. primary CTA = Demo / Try hosted (context-specific). secondary = Read benchmarks or Join webinar. wire webinar flows into header for Hosted and Dedicated; Private gets enterprise form.
Ashley (Analytics): routing plan: segment by CTA + org size. mapping:
```
Hosted CTA -> HubSpot form -> Lifecycle: developer -> List: hosted-inbound
Dedicated CTA -> HubSpot form -> Lifecycle: product-team -> List: dedicated-inbound
Private CTA -> Enterprise form -> Sales queue -> Priority tag: private
Webinar signup -> Webinar pipeline -> Source = launch-post
```
Sofia (Content): webinar blurb: "See benchmarks and migration patterns — live demo + Q&A." include line about cost/latency tradeoffs.
Ben (Design): layout note — include a compact benchmark card under hero (3 metrics: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/unit) with CTA to expand. keeps hero clean but signals credibility.
Maria (Growth): product marketing ask: add sentence calling out migration path: "Easily move from hosted to dedicated or private with the same API and tooling." keeps unified-runtime narrative.
Sofia (Content): microcopy: "Start on Hosted, scale to Dedicated, and secure with Private — all under one API and console." pushing to Google doc.
Ashley (Analytics): tagging: utm_campaign=launch_post, utm_content=hero_variantA/B, hidden field org_size. I'll create tracking ticket.
Jake (PM): run a soft A/B for hero variants on Hosted for week one. measure demo CTR >= 6% or webinar CTR >= 10%.
Ben (Design): will mock two hero cards in Figma and add benchmark card component to library.
Maria (Growth): timeline: Sofia drafts by EOD, Ben mocks by tomorrow noon, I'll queue launch post + webinar landing. Ashley confirm pipeline by EOD?
Ashley (Analytics): confirmed. creating HubSpot mapping + spec. ping for test data.
Sofia (Content): pushing copy: https://docs.google.com/launch-copy — please leave inline comments.
WebflowBot: new draft published to staging: /staging/launch/tri-mode-landing — preview https://staging.redwood.ai/tri-mode-landing
Jake (PM): QA checklist before publish: links, forms, utm, event tracking, benchmark numbers verified, webinar registration tested. who owns final sign-off?
Maria (Growth): I sign off on marketing copy + CTA. Jake signs off on routing & tracking. Ben signs off on layout.
Sofia (Content): tone: developer-first, add one enterprise line on Dedicated/Private pages. marking variants. :memo:
Ben (Design): adding callout styles for enterprise line so it doesn't clutter hero.
Maria (Growth): plan: push staging tomorrow afternoon, soft launch email + one launch post the following day. tagging: @Sofia (Content) @Ben (Design) @Ashley (Analytics) @Jake (PM).
Sofia (Content): adding webinar speaker blurbs + 3 routing Qs on signup form.
Ashley (Analytics): conditional routing: if org_size >= 500 -> Sales high-priority, else -> SDR nurture.
Jake (PM): keep hero variants short and measurable. scheduling 20m sync tomorrow if needed.
Maria (Growth): thanks team :thumbsup:
